reviews.text:
Shane and the reception team were absolutely amazing and so compassionate about helping us with Alley cat. She was treated with dignity and kindness. We can’t thank you enough for your kindness at this sad time.
Love Woodhaven

So happy with the care Colton have given my boy Bruce.
A big thank you to Bridie for making sure Bruce had plenty of cuddles while he was admitted.
A massive thank you to Emma and Shane for trying everything they can to make sure Bruce is back to his normal self.
He’s still in recovery fingers crossed everything you’ve done will work.
I couldn’t thank you all enough❤️
Love Charlotte, Danny and Bruce xxxx

Amazing emergency care, wasn’t registered and yet managed to see my poorly senior cat within an hour. Including time to get him there and registered with them. Whole process from first call to treatment and home was 5 hours. Triage, diagnosis, scans and sent away with medication all within this time, very considerate and clear on what needs to be done / recommendations and value for money given into account I had no pet insurance. My cat will now be on medication for the rest of his life and they were clear about everything couldn’t have asked for a better outcome given the condition he was in when I first decided to get him looked at by the vets here

Would give 100 stars if I could. My 13 year old dog, Bing, is under Shane for ongoing medical issues and treatment, he’s very complex and has got a lot of anxieties and fears and Shane is so understanding, supportive and caring, that it actually makes me a bit emotional. I’m so grateful we were lucky enough to find a vet who cares for my boy like Shane does, you literally cannot fault him, he’s always reassuring, and knowing he’s an older dog is always on hand if I have any questions or worries. Any animals I have in the future will 100% be registered with Colton vets for pets, no matter where we move to. The veterinary nurses are so kind and are always excited to see Bing and make his visits as easy as possible as they know how scared he is. Sending all the love in the world to these guys, they should be so proud to be so hardworking, caring and lovely🩷
There are very friendly, helpful and professional. I would use them again.
Excellent service when our dog was in labour and fantastic aftercare and staff so genuine i
All our pets have come here, from rattles to dogs, cats and skinks. Always caring staff and very knowledgeable vets. 100% recommended. X

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We really appreciate your support and are delighted to know you had a positive experience with our team. Thank you for choosing us to care for your pet—we look forward to seeing you again whenever you need us.

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 5-star rating. We truly appreciate your support and are delighted to know you had a positive experience with our team. We look forward to caring for your pet again whenever you need us.

Very good. They are great with my dogs and they like coming !
The staff are really good and helpful. Highly recommend x

Fantastic service from a professional, friendly, caring and skilful vet. I called not belong before closing time explaining that my dog was uncomfortable and needed attention. I was asked to come straight in (as Inca, the vet, wasn’t happy at the notion my dog should wait in discomfort for another day).  Inca diagnosed and treated my dog making him comfortable again. 10/10 service.

Great practice. Superb vet. David and his colleague work hard to look after all of your pets needs.
A special mention for Shaun who looked after Mabel when all was lost .

We said goodbye to our darling Rosie last week and we were truly devastated. John the vet spoke with me for as long as I needed and answered all my questions . He didn’t rush me , I’m sure he had other things to do .
We took Rosie back later that day so my husband could be there too , the room had a small lamp ( no bright lights) lovely blanket on the floor for Rosie to lay on , I laid on it with her. John was so kind and waited till we were ready . It was so peaceful and Rosie just went to sleep. I wanted to thank everyone so much for everything , you all clearly love animals so much 🥰 Julie

We have used this practice for six years since we got our Cockapoo and we could not have hoped for better care for him. As part of the family you want your pet to get the best care and they do provide that here. My dog has needed emergency treatment on a Christmas Eve and it was available without issue. On another occasion he needed surgery and not just the care, but the updates, the communication and the treatment were all first class. I had doubts initially as they are part of a chain but this has proved beneficial for the consistent availability of care and they are highly recommended. Very well organised, professional and an understanding of how much your pet means to you. Such a good team there as well and I thank all of them for looking after our boy so well.
Vets for Pets Colton, all wonderful caring staff, take such good care of Toby my little dog, and always take time to explain everything about his treatment in terms that I can understand
Saved my dogs leg ( john) there orthopedic vet X

We had to sadly say goodbye to our beautiful boy Caspar last night, but I cannot praise the care, respect and dignity given by all the Vets for Pets team enough.
I am so glad we chose to change to them a couple of years ago, because even though he was frightened of going, he always managed a bit of a tail wag for the amazing staff. Thank you so much for your fantastic support over the most difficult last weeks
Thank you for your review!

In the space of 1 month you have killed both of our rabbits 2 in the space of a month!! I understand there's risk to operations but when one was a standard everyday one and the other has it done every 5/6 weeks for the past year yet all of a sudden month after the first loss we lose another no you have KILLED them!!

The team here are amazing, they know my pooch well now and he's always eager to see them when we have a visit. It means a trip to the vets is less stressful as he's excited to see his pals and get some treats 😊 …

have no complaints regarding staff other than a manger who thinks it’s appropriate to make digs at a persons financial situation and imply they aren’t a responsible pet owner when they’ve been misinformed and their pet has been given medication that I didn’t agree too after stating to the vet  the medical choices I made for the animal weren’t just down to me, turning a £56 procedure into a £130+. He refused to believe the fact that his staff could have misinformed (which they did as I didn’t know it had been given to her until paying at the desk) I rang with a complaint and a solution for my current financial situation not for a lecture from a grown man. No one thinks they will end up having financial hardship as I didn’t when getting my puppy but unfortunately unexpected things happen which maybe he should consider before commenting on peoples financial situations as clearly he’s lucky enough to have not experienced anything like that due to the lack of understanding on his behalf, I completely understand I was highly frustrated and could have been more understanding he doesn’t make the rules but after reading reviews I’m clearly not the only one who has been previously been misinformed about pricing and procedures.

We had our beloved girl Teddy put to sleep on Monday 19th January.
Vets for Pets were honest, sincere, caring (towards all of us) and treat Teddy with kindness and dignity in her when her time came.
Everything was explained to us in great detail.  We had time to spend with her privately.  She was even given some chocolate which was just lovely.
The lights were turned down.
The vet and the nurses who cared for Teddy were superb.
Everyone we have ever seen there are genuine, animal lovers who don’t want to rip you off but want to do what is best for the animal and for the human.
Although it was heartbreaking - it was not traumatic.
Yesterday, I rang the vets to see if it was too late for me to get a clipping if Teddy’s fur.
Unbeknown to me, they had taken her fur and put it into little glass vials, took paw prints of her nose and paws and had them waiting for us with a sympathy card.
I thought this act of kindness was beautiful.  It made such a dark and horrible week better.
I am so grateful to everyone there.  All my family are.
I would not go anywhere else.
Thank you all so very much at Vets for Pets, Colton. ❤️
Great knowledgeable friendly staff

I am a regular client of Vets4pets at Colton as my dog has epilepsy. Recently, I lost 2 of my older cats within 24 hours. All the staff at this vets were amazingly kind and empathetic, with a special mention to Bridie. She has been so supportive and her kind words have comforted me over this heartbreaking period. I can’t thank them enough 🫶🏻

Have benn with Colton Vets4Pets for over 4 years, and they have been amazing every time we contacted them. All staff amazing, friendly, helpful.
I very highly recommend this practice!
Thank you so much
Excellent, always make sure a fuss of Jenny, she’s very nervous and they always manage to calm her.

These vets are so amazing my cat was ready to be put to sleep these vets helped her to keep going 12 years old and still going thanks to these vets I'm so grateful for all there help they are so amazing they so caring and do there job
Seen Amanda and Bridie today with my puppy, absolutely amazing! Lovely people and great with my puppy ❤️ thank you!!
Thank you for your 5 star review. it means a lot!
Always the very best of care here.

Yesterday, our beloved GSD Luna suddenly became lethargic and had an accident in the house. Worried, we called Vets4Pets in Colton and were told they could see her right away. we were given devastating news: Luna needed emergency surgery, and there was a chance she might not survive.

My husband and I have had Luna for eight years. essentially as long as we’ve been together. She is our whole world, and hearing that news felt like the ground had been pulled from beneath us.

Despite it being 4pm on a Friday, the team didn’t hesitate. They assured us they would operate immediately and stay as long as it took. Their selflessness, determination, and genuine compassion were far beyond anything we expected.

We waited in the car park for hours, and every single hour someone sent us an WhatsApp to update us, reassure us, and make sure we weren’t left in the dark. Their dedication carried us through one of the hardest nights of our lives.

They saved our girl’s life. There are no words strong enough to express our gratitude. Entrusting someone with your baby’s life is terrifying, but Luna could not have been in better hands.

Thank you, truly, to the entire team. you are extraordinary, and you all deserve a pay rise.

We are really happy with our puppy’s consultation today. They answered all our questions and went the extra mile to make sure she has everything she needs. Thank you very much to Amanda and the two nurses that saw Bella today!

We had to unfortunately put our rabbit Daisy to sleep this morning unexpectedly. I would just like to say an unconditional thank you to Inka and Emily for being so amazing with me, and Daisy! Inka went above and beyond to drop our carry case and the memory making items off at our house on her way home, which my partner who was at work at the time really really appreciated having. This was way above what was expected.

They were absolutely amazing and deserve some credit, I hope you can get them this message!

Thanks, Lewis & Jess♥️

Many thanks for your review. We appreciate that you have taken the time to give us a five-star rating, and we hope this helps others local to the practice to find us, so that we can meet and treat their precious pets.
A wonderful experience for my cat and I. Many thanks
Your five-star review is very much appreciated. Thank you for helping others to discover our friendly and professional service!
Thank you! We're really glad to know you were happy with the service we provided. It's what we're here for, and it's always nice to get such great feedback.
Thank you for your five-star review. As local Leeds vets, it means a lot! We hope to continue to provide you with the same friendly and affordable service in future.

Amazing, I called up for what I felt was an emergency and was told if you feel it is even more important, we can see your cat straight away, just come down, that is fantastic service and what I wanted to hear.
Amanda was just amazing. My cat came back home limping and not itself when walking and jumping. Naturally I was worried and scared for him. Amanda put me at ease, relaxed me with positive news and was absolutely spot on. Thank you for everything, wonderful vet, staff and all round service.

Hi there, thank you very much for your 5 star review! As friendly and helpful vets we are delighted to know that our service is rated so highly, and we look forward to continuing to care for your girls <3
Always excellent! Not the closest vets for me to visit but I won't take my rabbits anywhere else! Everyone here goes above and beyond every time! I trust them to do the best for my pets.

I have been with Vets for pets since, 2022... My 4 dogs are all registered with them, my previous vet retired I was with that practice 42 years....
Vets for pets do a great job with all my dogs, my favourite vet is Sara, she's so good with all of them... It's a very friendly practice and can recommend most highly.... Phot my beautiful Chihuahua Dora

Should be called Vets for Profit, not Vets for Pets. Read this — you’ve been warned.

I brought my dog in to have some stitches removed — they were from an accident while we were away, and had been put in by a different vet. While there, the attending vet (evidently fresh out of nappies and showing zero compassion) also advised that all of our dog’s canines needed to be removed.

Both my wife and I were shocked. She’s a qualified dental therapist — and while she works with human teeth, the biological structure of a tooth is the same. She immediately questioned the recommendation, which was not only extreme but would have seriously affected our dog’s ability to eat and his long-term wellbeing.

We sought a second opinion from an independent vet, who confirmed what we suspected: the advice was completely unnecessary and clearly profit-driven. They even spoke with the original vet who placed the stitches, who also agreed such a procedure was wholly unjustified.

This clinic made us feel pressured and fearful, showing no genuine concern for our dog’s welfare. I strongly recommend seeking an independent vet. Don’t take their word for it — they do not have your pet’s best interests at heart.

Vets4Pets are part of Companion Care, a profit-driven corporate group. To them, your beloved pet is just one thing: a cash cow.

We recently had to say good night to my first baby, my cat Poppy on 17/4. This was rather unexpected (although she was 20) as we were just taking her in for the vet to take a look at her teeth as she was having trouble eating. Unfortunately, it turned out to be the worst case scenario and we had to put her to sleep. The vet Shane explained everything very clearly to us and was empathetic, whilst remaining professional. The nurses were so kind and gave us tissues and offered condolences. It was such a hard time for me and my family but made easier from the kindness of everyone at Vets4Pets. I had to come back up a few days later as unfortunately we were charged for a cremation which was just human error. I did get rather upset but again was comforted by the lovely girl on reception (really sorry I didn’t take any other staff members/nurses names). In the same week, I had to bring my other cat up for her annual booster and we dealt with a different vet and nurse who were equally as lovely and made a fuss of Jessie (which was refreshing as our previous vets just wanted you in and out). Thank you again for your great service! Hopefully we don’t have to see you all again so soon, but we will be in safe hands if we do ☺️❤️

Attached is Poppy in the waiting room enjoying her last bit of Costa cream before going for her forever sleep 🐾
Really friendly and helpful, always gentle with our dog..will always give you the best advice even if it cost less...

Have taken a couple of kittens here to be neutered and unfortunately our eldest cat go to sleep. The receptionists and vets are absolutely fantastic. They make sure your checked in and seated in the right area and the vets are told your there. The waiting are is always spotlessly clean and if any pets have an accident it's instantly cleaned up and disinfected. The vets are caring and not just there to make money like I have experienced at other vets where they want you to throw money at them to keep a animal going. When our elderly cat had had a diagnosis they were honest and up front and explained everything perfectly which was great for my elderly mother (no wasn't getting her  euthanized yet) so I didn't have to explain it to her. The receptionist made sure we were looked after and we were shown to a low lit room with a nice fluffy blanket for our cat. After it was complete we were given a card with a collection of paw prints. This made a sad time easier. Other vets can charge £15 and over for print. If you want a place to take your loved fur / non fur babies to be cured , fixed etc then go here as the service is second to none.
Bobby went in today for his second jabs, he was very well looked after and all my questions were answered, all the staff being very helpful. Would highly recommend vets 4 pets here.
Had all the injections very good service

We had an old cat who was really struggling at the end of her life. From making the phonecall to attending the very sad process  of putting her to sleep all the staff were so very kind & professional. Thank you.

The staff are always friendly and helpful.
We love our visits and feel confident our dog Ezzy is well cared for .
Very friendly receptionists and doctors, explaining everything patently. Will recommend

I Would like to thank all the staff at Colton for looking after Rolo our little dog, but a massive thank you to Sara. Absolutely outstanding. She’s such a caring vet and the dedication she has stands out a mile!  We cannot thank you enough for everything you did for our little Rolo throughout the past 2 years . Sadly he didn’t make it to his last appointment with you but thank you for everything Sara.
We're so glad you had a positive experience at our local vet practice. Providing great pet care is our priority, and we look forward to seeing you and your pet for routine care soon!

Thank you for your review!  We’re glad to hear you had a positive experience at our vet practice. If there’s anything we can do to make your next visit even better, please don’t hesitate to let us know. We look forward to continuing to care for your pet.

Fantastic caring vets.
Cat tax added

I've had a wonderful experience of Colton Vets for Pets. I called up first thing and an urgent appointment was immediately available. The staff were all so friendly and caring and rang me regularly to update me about my cat Nala. The team all really tried to help me find the best treatment for Nala, bearing in mind my financial restrictions. During a really worrying, stressful week I honestly couldn't have asked for a better team. Special mention to Dave the vet who I found to be so knowledgeable, caring and kind. I will definitely be returning (hopefully not too soon though!)
Ridiculously expensive 🫰🏻 …

Called up this evening quite upset after receiving some fairly harsh advice from pets at home regarding fleas that sent me into a panic and spoke with Amy, she was absolutely amazing and gave me honest advice while also putting my mind …
